To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

the dynamics on 1 + N coupled landscapes can be mapped onto a single landscape in a higher dimensional space, and the eddy current emerges in the higher dimensional space as a sign of the non-equilibrium nonadiabatic dynamics.

the eddy current is a sign of non-adiabacity in discretely coupled non equilibrium systems, which plays an important role for the emergence of the non-equilibrium physical and biological phenomena such as enhancement of fluctuations, dissipation, irreversibility and optimal kinetics.

there exists mathematical equivalence of discretely coupled non-adiabatically evolving N-dimensional stochastic systems with one single N-dimensional continuous system with eddy current and many interesting physical effects emerge due to non-equilibrium nonadiabaticity.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the dynamics of a class of stochastic processes with multiple discrete and continuous degrees of freedom.
a general class of non-adiabatically coupled stochastic dynamics with applications to physical systems and gene regulatory networks.
the development of a unified mathematical framework to describe the non-adiability in the coupled continuous and discrete stochastic systems.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
we have developed a theory of non-adiabatc dynamics of discretely coupled continuous stochastic processes and applied it to self-activator and N-gene network.
we have developed a theory of multiple coupled landscapes with non-adiabtic dynamics with applications to the self-activating gene.
the eddy current plays a key role in the non-adiabolic dynamics and leads to the enhancement of fluctuations in the system.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
the eddy current emerges in the non-equilibrium nonadiabatic dynamics, plays an important role and leads to many interesting effects.
there is a general mathematical framework for the description of non-adiabatically coupled continuous and discrete processes.
the non-equilibrium dynamics in a discretely coupled continuous stochastic system can be mapped onto one single extended landscape in 2(N) dimensions.
The main takeaway from our work is that
non-adiabatcity plays an essential role in the evolution of many physical and chemical systems and the emergence of non-equilibrium effects such as irreversibility, fluctuation and dissipation.
the eddy current plays an important role for the non-equilibrium dynamics of discretely coupled continuous stochastic systems and the eddy current is the signature of non-equilibrium dynamics.
the non-adiabiaticity is the key factor for the emergence of the new physical effects and the new timescale, which is absent for the dynamics on a single landscape.
